neighbours.label: the tokens ' pulp', ' gulp', 'ulp' (pulp, gulp, gulping, Pulp); other '-lp' / '-ump' words (help, yelp, pump, kelp) are quiet
fire: The factory grinds old newspapers into pulp and presses it into egg boxes.
She swallowed the medicine in one gulp and made a face.
The thirsty hikers were gulping water straight from the stream.
Scoop out the pulp of the mango with a spoon.
He read cheap pulp magazines on the train to work.
The dog gulped down its dinner in a few seconds.
Paper is made from wood pulp that has been bleached and dried.
With a nervous gulp, the boy stepped onto the stage.
quiet: The factory grinds old newspapers into flakes and presses them into egg boxes.
She swallowed the medicine in one go and made a face.
The thirsty hikers were drinking water straight from the stream.
Scoop out the flesh of the mango with a spoon.
He asked for help with the bicycle pump on the way to work.
The dog wolfed down its dinner and let out a yelp.
Paper is made from wood fibre that has been bleached and dried.
With a firm clasp of her hand, the boy stepped onto the stage.

notes: Layer 3, very sparse. Card: ' pulp' x14, 'ulp' x7, 'ping' (gul-ping) x4, ' gulp'.
